about: How money and hours are WRITTEN on the invoice PDF (ovation#167, PRD 50c). Read by scripts/test-design-rules.sh against docs/design/rules/pdf-text.js and by OvationTests/PDFTextTests.swift against the app, so the settled design and the rendered PDF cannot write one figure two ways (L26). The invoice screen writes figures differently on purpose and has its own formatter.

money.why: a comped invoice totals nothing, and nothing is still drawn (PRD 5.1b)
a single digit of cents keeps its leading zero
below zero the minus sits before the dollar sign, even under a dollar
the hourly rate, the commonest figure on the page
a referral credit of one hour
thousands are separated by a comma
every group of three is separated, not only the first

hours.why: the one hour shoot, 16 of 19 real bookings, keeps its settled spelling
a half hour needs one decimal
whole hours keep one decimal, as the design writes them
a quarter needs two decimals; one decimal printed 1.3 and the arithmetic stopped adding up
the commonest quarter in Dan's history, eleven lines
on neither a quarter nor a tenth, and in the history
the longest line Dan has ever billed

hourly.why: a quarter hour line reconstructs from what is printed
a value on neither a quarter nor a tenth
a comped hour prints a rate and an amount of nothing
